findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council conducted regular business covering the annual property tax levy, a revolving loan request for a local business, surplus equipment disposal, and a downtown TIF grant. Commissioners also approved advisory board reappointments, authorized a boiler replacement for the police department, and commended city crews and first responders.
